title: Battle of Khyber Pass (1738)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Khyber Pass (1738)", at revision 1370445280, opens: "The Battle of Khyber Pass was an engagement fought on 26 November 1738 between the Afsharid Iran of Nader Shah and the Mughal vassal state of Peshawar. The result of the battle was an overwhelming victory for the Iranians, opening up the path ahead to invade the crown-lands of the Mughal Empire of Muhammad Shah." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q18124347, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1738 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
